$comment: Where `catalog`'s inventory stops, and which side the gap is on.
AGENTS.md admits nothing to the component inventory that does not name one exact,
renderable kit node, and admits nothing that does not invoke the exact named Glimmer
API. Those two rules meet in the middle for twelve components. Everywhere else they
disagree, and the disagreement is worth recording rather than leaving implied: an
unmapped kit set and an unmapped Compose API look identical in a coverage report, and
neither says whether somebody decided or nobody looked.
A declaration here is a CHECKED gap, the way kit-unauthorable.json is for axis values.
scripts/glimmer-kit-gaps.mjs reads it in both directions:
* a kit node the gap names must still be in the imported page cache, and must still be
unlinked — a node that has gained a sticker means the gap closed and the declaration
has to go;
* a `searchedPage` must still be in the cache, and must still hold nothing matching the
component this catalog went looking for — the day the kit publishes one, this fails;
* a sample file must still exist;
* and every declaration pins the library version its API evidence was read from, so a
Renovate bump fails the check until a human re-reads the new surface. That is the
trigger #433 asks for, wired to the thing that actually moves.
What this file is NOT: an exemption. Nothing here is published as a mapped component,
nothing here gets an invented `reference`, and none of it is a licence to rebuild a kit
component out of lower-level surfaces to match pixels.
The API surface every `api-gap` below was read from. `version` must equal the
`glimmer` entry in gradle/libs.versions.toml; Renovate owns that pin, so the day it
moves this file fails until somebody re-reads the AAR.
Read from the published AAR's classes, not from documentation. `components` below is
that surface: every public component composable alpha20 exports. 1.0.0-alpha20 is
also the newest version the androidx maven repository publishes, so `none published
yet` in a declaration means exactly that, not `not in the version we happen to pin`.
Each entry is either INVOKED by a sticker in catalog/src/main/kotlin or named
in a declaration's `apis`. That is the completeness statement #414 asked for, and it
is checked rather than asserted: an API this repository stops calling, and an API a
new release adds, both fail the check.

declarations.reason: Glimmer publishes a pager; the kit publishes no Pager node. Under the design-led inventory rule a component with no exact kit cell does not enter the inventory, and mapping it to a neighbouring container would publish a picture claiming to depict something else.
declarations.evidence: The kit's `🧩 Components` page (8:312) lays out Cards, Buttons, Lists, Stacks, Button groups, Progress indicator, Voice indicator, Entity and Title chips. No page in the imported cache carries a node whose name contains `pager`. The sample stays visible in `samples-catalog`, which is upstream's own preview and not a mapped component.

declarations.reason: The kit's Entity set covers avatar, contained icon, monogram, adaptive product, image, app, system and progress presentations at several sizes. Glimmer publishes no Entity composable; `Icon` is one content primitive that an Entity would contain, not an implementation of it. Mapping `Icon` to this set would break the exact named-API rule and make the render claim to depict a component it never invokes.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's AAR exports IconKt.Icon and no Entity of any kind. `IconSamples.kt` stays a sample in `samples-catalog`, which is upstream's preview rather than a mapped component; bare Icon has no kit node of its own either.
declarations.closesWhen: Glimmer publishes an Entity composable, or the kit publishes an Icon set.

declarations.reason: Four published progress component sets under the kit's Progress indicator frame (40000116:7000), with no Glimmer API to invoke. Rebuilding them from lower-level drawing primitives would put a replica in the inventory that tests nothing the library ships.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's AAR exports no progress-indicator composable — no ProgressIndicator, no LinearProgressIndicator, no CircularProgressIndicator — and 1.0.0-alpha20 is the newest version androidx publishes, so no release exposes these yet.
declarations.closesWhen: A Glimmer release exposes the progress APIs. Each set then lands in its own PR, with its variant axes folded behind the default sticker and the set added to figma-kit-index.json with strict map coverage.

declarations.reason: The orientation-parameterised base of `GlimmerLazyColumn`. The kit publishes `1-line list` and `2-line list`, which the column sticker is already the rendition of; a second component invoking the generic overload would resolve to the same nodes and publish one picture under two names.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's GlimmerLazyListKt exports GlimmerLazyColumn and GlimmerLazyList(orientation, …); the kit's list sets carry no orientation axis to distinguish them.
declarations.closesWhen: The kit publishes a horizontal list node.

declarations.reason: The kit publishes a disabled row at both line counts. alpha20's `ListItem` takes no `enabled` parameter at all, so there is no call this catalog could make that draws one — which is why the list stickers carry `@GlimmerInteractionStates` rather than `@GlimmerStates`.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's ListItemKt exposes `ListItem` with content slots, an `onClick` and no `enabled`; the disabled treatment is not reachable from any overload.

declarations.reason: The kit's `List Item` set carries a third `Type` value, `Card`, at all four states. Glimmer publishes `Card` and `ListItem` as separate components and no card-shaped row type on `ListItem`; drawing a Card inside a list and calling it a ListItem cell would map pixels to an API that was never invoked.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's ListItemKt has no type or shape parameter — `Type=1-line` and `Type=2-line` are the supporting-label slot, and nothing reaches the Card row.
declarations.closesWhen: Glimmer publishes a card row type on `ListItem`.

declarations.reason: Shapes, Colors, Typography, Surface and DepthEffectLevels are token types, and their design counterparts are specimens on the kit's `🎨 Styles` page rather than component sets on `🧩 Components`. Publishing them as @CatalogComponent cards would blur token documentation into the component inventory and invent an exact component reference the kit does not offer.
declarations.evidence: The Styles specimens are imported read-only as the eight pages listed above, addressable by node id through design/pages/pages.json — which is the generated token inventory, and the only one the kit supports without a component set to point at. The samples stay in `samples-catalog` as upstream's own previews.
declarations.closesWhen: The catalog schema gains an explicit token/foundation representation, or the kit publishes a component set per token type. Each token type then lands in its own PR.

declarations.reason: alpha20 adds two cards that put the image BESIDE the content rather than above it. The kit's `Card` set (416:2700) carries its image as a `Show Image` layer above the title, which is what `ImageCard` draws and what the `Card` `content=image` variant renders; it has no layer or axis for a side image, so mapping these to it would publish a layout the node does not depict.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's Card.kt exports ImageCard, LeadingImageCard and TrailingImageCard, and removes `Card`'s `header` slot; alpha19 exported none of the three. The Cards page (4116:3165) caches only the `Card` set and its instances, and no cached node is named like a leading or trailing image. The samples render in `samples-catalog` as upstream's own previews.
declarations.closesWhen: The kit publishes a side-image card node. Each then lands in its own PR.

declarations.reason: alpha20 adds `AlertDialog`; the kit's `🧩 Components` page lays out no dialog. A component with no exact kit cell does not enter the inventory.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's AlertDialog.kt exports AlertDialog(onDismissRequest, confirmButton, text, …); alpha19 did not. No cached page carries a node whose name contains `dialog`. Upstream's AlertDialogSamples.kt is vendored but declares no @Preview, so it has no render in `samples-catalog` either.
declarations.closesWhen: The kit publishes a dialog node.

declarations.reason: alpha20 adds `IconMarker`; the kit publishes no marker node. `IconMarkerDefaults.DotIcon` is its default content rather than a component of its own.
declarations.evidence: alpha20's IconMarker.kt exports IconMarker (clickable and non-clickable); the alpha19 AAR contained no IconMarker class, which is why IconMarkerSamples.kt was quarantined until this pin. No cached page carries a node whose name contains `marker`. The samples render in `samples-catalog`.
declarations.closesWhen: The kit publishes an icon marker node.
